CustomField.description: Used to visually display a progress bar
CustomField.formula:
IF( AllWorksItemsCount__c = 0, IMAGE("/resource/Progress_Block_Empty_1", "", 10, 100) & " 0%",
IMAGE( "/resource/Progress_Block_Primary_1", "Complete", 10, CompletionPercent__c * 100 ) &
IMAGE( "/resource/Progress_Block_Empty_1", "Remaining", 10, (1 - CompletionPercent__c) * 100 ) &
" " &
TEXT(ROUND(CompletionPercent__c * 100, 0)) &
"%" )
CustomField.label: Project Completion
